youtube_title: Old Woodville: the Oklahoma town under Lake Texoma (Kingston request)
body: You asked for Kingston, Oklahoma! Near Kingston there's a town at the bottom of a lake. Woodville began in 1881 as Harney, in the Chickasaw Nation, and was renamed in 1888. Then came the Denison Dam on the Red River: Congress authorized it in 1938 and work began in 1939. Woodville stood where the lake would be, so the people had to go; some moved to a new town, New Woodville. The dam was finished in 1944, Lake Texoma rose, and old Woodville went under. In the drought of 2011, the water dropped and the town's foundations came back into the light. If the lake ever shows you the old town, look, but don't take anything: it's federal land, and removing artifacts is against the law. Comment your town, and it could be next! #Kingston #Oklahoma #LakeTexoma #MarshallCounty #GhostTown #History #LaPorteAfterDark
